title: Lignin_Forward_Gen: a forward kinetic Monte Carlo generator for linkage-resolved lignin structure
description:
A minimal, transparent forward kinetic Monte Carlo generator that predicts the native lignin inter-unit linkage inventory (β-O-4, β-5, β-β, β-1, 5-5, 4-O-5) from monomer composition (S/G ratio) alone.

Unlike backward generators, which are given target bond fractions and reproduce them, this generator evolves structure from radical-coupling propensities, so the linkage distribution is an emergent output rather than an input. Seven coupling constants are calibrated by Nelder-Mead against three native wood anchors (softwood, poplar and a high-syringyl hardwood) and validated by leave-one-out cross-validation.

The repository contains the generator, its calibration and validation scripts, the parameter-recovery and sensitivity experiments, the matched cross-generator comparison harness, and every result log reproducing the accompanying paper. All runs are seeded and deterministic.
